title: Man found dead in Queensland flood waters as state hit by multiple storms and days-long deluge
byline: Australian Associated Press; Guardian staff reporter
paragraphs: A man’s body has been found in flood waters following an unusual weather system that delivered multiple storms and a days-long deluge to parts of Australia.
Emergency services were called to a creek at Boompa on Queensland’s Fraser Coast shortly after 11am on Monday after reports a man had been found unresponsive.
The man was declared dead after being found in Smothering Creek on Boompa Road, Queensland police said.
